capabilities: Export notes to PDF in print-optimized or formatting-preserving mode
Force page breaks with === or a page-break callout
Configure page size, orientation, margins, font size and page-number style
Embed vault and remote images at their specified sizes
Typeset display math and shrink code blocks to fit
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); not yet in the community plugin list, so it must be installed manually from a release. Bundled MathJax adds about 1.7 MB to main.js. Non-Latin scripts, symbols and emoji need user-supplied fallback fonts. No telemetry; the only network requests are downloads of remote images during export.
problem: PDF exports of notes give no control over page breaks, page size, margins, fonts or page numbers, and either drop Obsidian's styling or print it in a form unsuitable for paper.
summary: Note-to-PDF exporter that renders a note through Obsidian's reading view and writes a PDF with print-optimized or formatting-preserving styling and layout settings.
